title: rhodiola stephani
intro: Rhodiola stephani, commonly known as Arctic rhodiola, is a flowering plant species in the family Crassulaceae. Rhodiola stephani is known for its adaptogenic properties and has been traditionally used to reduce stress and improve mental performance. The health benefits of Rhodiola stephani include reducing fatigue, anxiety, and depression, as well as improving cognitive function and memory. Its therapeutic actions are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, which include rosavin, salidroside, and tyrosol, that have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
